proves.claim: With items.barRulesAtAdd on, a bar naming a path missing from main that an unmerged open or verified item branch adds is refused AFTER_NEEDED unless --after names it.

cli.io-item-bar-after.names-the-item-a-m.why: Without it, a bar naming a file an accepted item has not landed would be filed and then released BLOCKED, costing a claim cycle.

proves.claim: The AFTER_NEEDED refusal names each such item id with its file and the next step rerun with --after <id>.

cli.io-item-bar-after.refusal-names-each.why: Without it, a bar naming a file an accepted item has not landed would be filed and then released BLOCKED, costing a claim cycle.

proves.claim: With the setting off, or a missing path no unmerged item branch adds, add and edit accept the bar as today.

cli.io-item-bar-after.accepts-the-bar-wi.why: Without it, a bar naming a file an accepted item has not landed would be filed and then released BLOCKED, costing a claim cycle.
